modalities.evidence: functional MRI data along with two functional localizer tasks

output.population: Human; Healthy / Control; 119 late, unbalanced Polish-English bilinguals, ages 18–34
output.summary: Structural and functional MRI dataset of late unbalanced Polish-English bilinguals. Includes anatomical T1 scans plus functional scans and fieldmaps for a first-language localizer and a multiple-demand network localizer.
